name: Flameskull

actions.name: Fireball
actions.effect: A 6m radius explosion at a point within medium range. All creatures must pass PHYS save for half damage. Usable twice per encounter.

actions.name: Magic Missile
actions.effect: Three missiles of magical force strike targets of the Flameskull's choice. This attack automatically hits (no roll needed).

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.effect: Creates a magical barrier. +5 to all defenses against one attack.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: Sheds dim light in a 5m radius.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If destroyed, the Flameskull reforms in 1 hour with full HP unless holy water is sprinkled on its remains or a dispel magic spell is cast on them.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: +1d6 to saves against spells and magical effects.

lore: Flameskulls are the disembodied, burning skulls of dead wizards, animated by dark magic to serve as guardians. They retain some of their arcane knowledge and attack intruders with devastating fire magic.
